messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled change window in ~9h (starts 2024-07-15 02:00 UTC). Deep-freeze policy: T-2h hard freeze, T-9h advisory. Pinning prod to v2024.4.2 now. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/2024-4-2 :rotating_light:

sarah: Copy. Confirming canary settings and rollback plan please. :white_check_mark:

miguel: Canary = 3% for first 10m, ramp to 15% over 30m if metrics look good. Autoscale temporarily disabled for the pool.

anita: Ops on-call assigned: @ops-jun 01:30-05:00 UTC. I'll be reachable for DB checks.

ops-jun: On it. I'll run smoke and tail the inference logs. Add me to the runbook slack snippet.

lee: heads-up: no DB or P0 config changes after T-3h. That includes KVS and schema flags.

miguel: canary metrics to watch: p50 latency < 150ms, p95 < 400ms, error-rate < 0.1%, embedding-cost delta < +15%.

sarah: quick preflight checklist (callout):
- smoke tests: load + basic prompts (scripts updated)
- canary dashboards ready
- rollback commands verified
- release notes and customer-facing blurb ready

derek: posting rollback snippet here, kept minimal:
```
# rollback to previous pinned release
deploy-tool rollback --service inference --to v2024.4.1 --reason "canary_regression"
# emergency unpin (if deploy-tool unresponsive)
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference inference=image:2024.4.1 --record
```

sarah: Also documenting the escape-hatch flow: 1) detect regression -> 2) cut canary -> 3) run rollback command -> 4) notify #incidents and customers if SLA impacted. Keep comms short.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: prod -> v2024.4.2 (pinned by @sarah). Pin TTL: indefinite until manual unpin. :pushpin:

miguel: I'll attach the smoke-run link and test corpus here: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/rls-2024-4-2/smoke  (results should appear ~T-6h)

anita: small ask: if we hit a token-cost spike, hold rollout and alert finance on-call. Tag @derek.

derek: acknowledged. I set an alert for +20% token-unit burn to Pagetopic.

sarah: final ask: anyone planning last-minute minor tweaks? speak now or we'll enforce freeze at T-2h.

lee: no last-minute changes from eng-runtime. All good. :thumbsup:

ops-jun: I'll join the preflight sync at T-2h-15m in #eng-releases and run through runbook step-by-step.

sarah: thank you all — we'll reconvene at T-2h and post go/no-go. If anything pops before then, @channel.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: preflight alert in 2h (will ping this thread).
